plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Carl Sagan, the famous American astronomer and science writer, wrote about UFOs in his diary as a boy and often debated them with his mentor. According to Michels, Sagan somehow flipped to being strongly against the idea of UFOs, as seen in his book The Demon-Haunted World, a defense of scientific skepticism. Michels raises this turn in a discussion about UFOs and religion, as a puzzle about why a believer became a leading doubter.
